correctness.rationale: With strictly positive configuration weights, equality in Hilbert–Schmidt contraction for a peripheral eigenmatrix forces every conjugation of it to give the same phase times that matrix. The empty subset then forces phase 1. Off πℤ the singleton exponential has unequal phases on the span of |u⟩−|v⟩ and its orthogonal complement, so a fixed matrix commutes with that rank-one projector, or equivalently with the vertex swap. Connected-edge swaps generate all permutations (a distant transposition is obtained by conjugating along a path). A matrix commuting with these has constant diagonal and constant off-diagonal entries, and the uniform-vector projection P and I−P indeed commute with every configuration. Bounded powers exclude Jordan blocks on the unit circle; the two conserved sector traces give the asserted projection in every matrix norm. Its diagonals are 1/n, its off-diagonals are (nw−1)/(n(n−1)), and its two sector eigenvalues give the claimed purity. At τ in πℤ the one-edge graph has identity evolution for both configurations, so graph-uniform sharpness holds. Frozen numerical evidence was inspected, not relied on for the theorem.
residual_risks: No sample-path, continuous-time convergence, graph-uniform rate, or full resonant classification for each graph is implied.

The frozen scalar observables and one-edge identity do not constitute a distinct surviving result. This is a failure of distinctness against existing indexed coverage, not a finding that the indexed record was written first: it is catalogued under 2026/11/2, whereas the frozen item is catalogued under 2026/10/26. value.rationale: As a mathematical statement the all-graph fixed-step theorem is worthwhile: flat marginals alone cannot tell whether the channel erases coherence, and the exact two-sector limit answers that question for all initial states and interior retentions while isolating a sharp switching obstruction. This value judgment does not make the frozen claim distinct from the indexed theorem.
residual_risks: Does not supply rates uniform in graph size, or any new result about the fixed graph resonances beyond a simple witness.
